description: Bitcoin Taproot script-path m-of-n multisig: one CHECKSIGADD leaf under the BIP341 NUMS internal key (no key path), from x-only or compressed PUBLIC keys + threshold + network (bitcoin default, testnet, signet, regtest). Returns address, leaf_script, control_block, merkle_root, internal_key and descriptor. Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

pubkeys.description: Public keys in order (order is consensus-significant)
